notes.title: Our Next Game Announcement
notes.content:
We’re thrilled today, to unveil the first teaser trailer for ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL, and you can watch it right here on STEAM:



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591790/ANIMAL_USE_PROTOCOL/




[previewyoutube=aws6p_Z_2uc;full][/previewyoutube]



Unlike our past games, AUP will be first-person and lean towards survival horror. 

[b]You can still expect a deep, gut-wrenching narrative that will test our characters' bonds to their limits.
[/b]

Play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee, leading the desperate escape of lab animals from a nightmarish research facility, Anchorage Station.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/dbd5e83859782b08cb670886151fca80aaf5b43d.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/8a98346e0a60eba099714da22e21d239c9890307.gif[/img]


Penn is joined by Trip, a scrappy, smart-ass rat - with your help, they’ll survive long enough to save their fellow lab animals.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/36ae17f95c573359bfd352d37d45b6bd687fdb44.gif[/img]


Using a gravity-manipulation, physics-based tool, you’ll handle heavy and hazardous materials both offensively and creatively in problem-solving.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/01103ec14791a6807abaed44c860158d0ad24c45.gif[/img]


[b]You need to be quiet as a mouse...
...but bold as a rat![/b]


The STEAM page is live, and you can add ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL to your Wishlist right now.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591790/ANIMAL_USE_PROTOCOL/

We’re excited to share more of what we’re working on, so be sure to Wishlist and follow our social media on X: [url=https://twitter.com/StasisGame]@StasisGame[/url] or join our mailing list at [url=https://www.animaluseprotocol.com]https://www.animaluseprotocol.com[/url]

notes.title: Mick Gordon will be working on Beautiful Desolation and STASIS/CAYNE are on sale!
notes.content:
If you haven't checked out STASIS, now is a great time to do it! 

All versions are on sale!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/380150/STASIS/

CAYNE deluxe is also on sale

http://store.steampowered.com/app/532840/CAYNE/

[h1]Update on our next game, Beautiful Desolation[/h1]

Great news! 

Award-winning composer, Mick Gordon, will use his broad experience to tell Beautiful Desolation’s auditory story. We’re thrilled to have such a talent translate our ideas into a sound unique to this game universe.

To many he needs no introduction, as Mick has score titles such as DOOM, Wolfenstein: The New Order and Microsoft’s Killer Instinct reboot under his belt (we said award-winning, right?!); so every note and precisely placed chord will draw you in.

His use of both traditional and modern techniques, and sometimes unconventional musical pairings, matches Desolation’s tribalpunk clash of old and new.

Collaborating with an experienced and passionate artist, who considers the role of the game’s music as a translation of its environment, allows for us to the convey ideas, emotions and backstory for each track.

This way Mick fully appreciates and applies this from the outset to create his own musical vision.

You can find out about Mick here: http://www.mick-gordon.com/

[h1]A few new screenshots[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/4cd445f8d20ec0cd1119c615afe2723eeef347d5.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/-Cwbo2BUXUc

Sign up on our site to get a notification when we launch on Steam:

http://www.desolationgame.com

Take care,

-Chris

notes.title: Cayne, the free horror adventure from the makers of Stasis, comes out tomorrow
notes.content:
Cayne, the point-and-click horror-adventure from Stasis studio The Brotherhood, will be released tomorrow on Steam. Promised as part of the 2013 Stasis Kickstarter, the "prequel chapter" has been built "from the ground up," as developer Chris Bischoff explained last year, which is why it's taken so long to complete, and it will be free for everyone. 

Cayne follows the story of Hadley, a woman nine months pregnant who awakens in a mysterious facility with no memory of how she got there. It promises fully-rendered 3D characters and HD backgrounds, professional voice acting, FMV sequences, and "intuitive puzzles to test your deductive skills." A "deluxe content" upgrade, with 4K wallpapers, the game script, and the soundtrack, will also be available for purchase.   

Experience with Stasis isn't necessary—Cayne is an "adjunct story"—but it is a really good game, so if that sort of blood-soaked horror experience is your thing, I'd definitely recommend it. You can get a feel for what's in store in the trailer below.
